item.title: Day Seven of Early Voting Adds 534 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-seven early voting report shows 534 in-person voters Sunday, bringing the seven-day in-person total to 11,586, which the county reports as 28.05 percent turnout.

item.title: Commissioners to weigh Corley Road closeout, Comfort setback request Tuesday
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court will consider Corley Road Phase 1 closeout items and a Comfort setback relief request on October 27, with a TxDOT update on SH 46 West set for November 10.

item.title: Court to discuss 120 acres near Comfort in closed session Tuesday
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court will meet in closed session Tuesday, October 27, to discuss a possible purchase of 120 acres near Comfort previously owned by the Hawkins family; the posted agenda names no seller and no price.

item.title: New Natural Area Nears Opening on Highway 46
item.description: The Albert and Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area between Boerne and Bandera is targeting a late fall 2026 opening, with 28 miles of multi-use trail planned.

item.title: Day Six of Early Voting Adds 1,015 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-six early voting report shows 1,015 in-person voters Saturday, bringing the six-day in-person total to 11,052, which the county reports as 26.76 percent turnout.

item.title: The Man the County Is Named For Died 159 Years Ago This Week
item.description: George Wilkins Kendall, the journalist and sheepman for whom Kendall County is named, died at his ranch on October 21, 1867, at age 58. He rests in Boerne Cemetery under its only Texas Historical Commission marker.

item.title: Greyhounds stay perfect at 8-0 after pole fire delays homecoming win
item.description: Boerne High beat Veterans Memorial 49-7 on Friday for homecoming to stay 8-0, after a parking lot light pole fire at halftime delayed the game nearly two hours. Champion fell 35-24 at Smithson Valley, Comfort won 39-0, and Geneva beat Holy Cross 23-21.

item.title: What is on the November 3 ballot in Kendall County
item.description: A race-by-race guide to the Nov 3 Kendall County ballot, drawn from the county's sample ballot: the statewide ticket, two contested local races, a list of unopposed county offices, and Comal ISD's two bond propositions.

item.title: Sisterdale gets its first postmaster, 175 years ago
item.description: On October 23, 1851, Ottmar von Behr became the first postmaster of Sisterdale, the Latin Settlement founded by Nicolaus Zink in 1847. 175th anniversary.

item.title: Court to vote on Salazar memorial highway marker
item.description: Commissioners Court will consider a highway sign agreement designating the Officer Russell 'Rusty' Salazar Memorial Highway on US 87, per the October 27 agenda.

item.title: Court to weigh 90-day burn ban Tuesday
item.description: Commissioners Court will consider a 90-day outdoor burning ban Tuesday, plus a wildfire-resilience block covering fire-hardened home programs and a possible wildland-urban interface code, per the October 27 agenda.

item.title: Bravo reality series set in Boerne names one of five women as a local
item.description: Bravo's Small Town Trouble: Texas, a reality series set in Boerne, premieres November 18; the network's own cast bios identify only one of the five women as a Boerne local, and the public record states no current hometown for three of the others.

item.title: This Weekend in Boerne and Kendall County: October 23-25
item.description: Weekend roundup for October 23-25: Boerne Boo, All British Car Day, antique tractor pull, bluegrass jam, trunk-or-treats, library events, live music and more around Boerne and Kendall County.

item.title: KCSO warns meat markets of phone-order scam
item.description: KCSO warns meat markets about an ongoing phone-order scam, per JAM Broadcasting on October 22.

item.title: Fair Oaks Ranch officer honored for saving a life
item.description: Fair Oaks Ranch Police Officer Michael De Hoyos received the American Heart Association's Heart Saver Hero Award for a November 2025 cardiac rescue, per the Boerne Star on October 21.

item.title: Day Three of Early Voting Adds 1,972 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-three early voting report shows 1,972 in-person voters Wednesday, bringing the three-day in-person total to 6,285, or 15.22 percent.

item.title: New Boerne business park pledges profits to fight human trafficking
item.description: Freedom Place Business Park is under construction on I-10 in Boerne: seven buildings and 82,000 square feet aimed at tradesmen and small companies. Developer Ben Briggs says a significant share of the project's profits will go to organizations fighting human trafficking, with a long-term goal of giving 50 million dollars through future projects.

item.title: Day Two of Early Voting Adds 2,148 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-two early voting report shows 2,148 in-person voters Tuesday, bringing the two-day in-person total to 4,313, or 10.44 percent.

item.title: Boerne council clears annexation, rezoning, and dealership permit on IH-10; adopts AI ethics code
item.description: Boerne City Council gave first-reading approval to annexation, rezoning, and a special use permit for an auto dealership on 13.4 acres along IH-10; adopted the state AI code of ethics; renewed the Fair Oaks Ranch animal control agreement; and heard a year-long plan to rebuild the weedy soccer fields. October 13, 2026. All votes 5-0.

item.title: Special court session Friday to decide EMS Medical Director talks
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court called a special session for Friday, October 23, at 9 a.m. to consider ending EMS Medical Director negotiations with Archangel EMV LLC and pivoting to the evaluation committee's recommended candidate under RFQ 2026-14.
